hypothesis: Sampled producer phase profiling adds less than 2% fixed-work throughput overhead while preserving equivalent emulated work.
invalidationRules: use the verified reference-battle fixed battle with SAVE_STATE_AT=0 and no gameplay input
both arms require metrics=1 and the same core, save state, browser, presenter, JIT, staging, and renderer settings
the profiled arm must report the fixed v1 producer-profile schema, phase order, positive periods, stable epoch, and monotonic counters
each ABBA/BAAB block must remain below 2% throughput regression
actual core-tick and frame work must remain within 5% between arms
stopRule: Require two complete ABBA/BAAB blocks; reject any block with >=2% profiling regression, non-equivalent semantic work, or invalid producer-profile evidence.
